text: dsh-pi-ai-sync 是一个用于 DSH 的模型目录与设置同步插件。它按 provider route 从 pi.dev 获取模型清单，将缺少的记录合并到本机 pi-ai catalog，并可按配置保留、移除或镜像 DSH 的 models 设置；支持启动后及定时刷新，也可通过命令或服务手动触发。适合希望让 pi.dev 上的新模型进入 DSH 选择器的用户。无需 API key；同步会访问 pi.dev，catalog 变化后需要重启 DSH 生效。

dsh-pi-ai-sync syncs pi.dev provider models into DSH. It adds missing records to the local pi-ai catalog and can unset or mirror model settings. Startup and interval refreshes run automatically; a command and service allow manual runs. No API key is configured. Catalog changes need a DSH restart.
想让 DSH 自动补齐 pi.dev 上新增的 provider 模型。
如何把 pi.dev 的模型目录同步到本机 pi-ai catalog？
希望模型清单定时刷新，不用手动改 node_modules。
让 DSH 的模型选择器显示上游新模型。
Keep my DSH provider model catalog in sync with pi.dev.
Refresh DSH model settings from each provider route automatically.
dsh-pi-ai-sync 的功能「同步 provider 模型目录」：对配置的路由请求 pi.dev 列表，把 catalog 缺少且记录有效的模型按 API 协议分组写入本机 pi-ai catalog；新模型在 DSH 重启后生效。
dsh-pi-ai-sync 的功能「调整 DSH 模型列表」：按 unset、mirror 或 keep 模式处理路由的 models 设置；镜像模式可包含 catalog 独有模型，并会跳过带 modelOverrides 的路由。
dsh-pi-ai-sync 的功能「定时或手动刷新」：插件启动后延迟执行并按间隔自动刷新；也注册 /pi-ai-sync 命令和 piAiSync.syncNow 服务以触发单轮同步。
dsh-pi-ai-sync 使用 Node fetch 向 pi.dev 请求各 provider route 的模型列表；代码未配置 API key。

dsh-pi-ai-sync README · dsh-pi-ai-sync：A [dsh](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) Cordis plugin that keeps
provider routes in step with the pi.dev gateway by maintaining **both** layers a
model has to pass through:

- the **pi-ai catalog** (`@earendil-works/pi-ai/dist/providers/data/<route>.json`)
  — the "does dsh know this model and which protocol does it speak?" layer, and
- the **settings model list** (`llm-pi-ai.providers.<route>.models`) — the
  "does the model picker offer it?" layer.

dsh-pi-ai-sync README · dsh-pi-ai-sync：It is the fusion of
[`dsh-model-sync`](https://github.com/fan56/dsh-model-sync) (settings seam) and
[`dsh-opencode-go-models`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-opencode-go-models)
(pi-ai catalog file), with no hand-maintained protocol/family tables: pi.dev's
listing already carries every record in pi-ai catalog shape.

dsh-pi-ai-sync README · Why：dsh resolves a configured model's wire protocol as
`route.api ?? catalog[id].api ?? sharedCatalogApi(route)`. On the dsh 0.1.x line
the settings model schema has **no per-model `api` field**, so:

dsh-pi-ai-sync README · Why：- routes with a single protocol are fine — the route-level api fills the gap;
- a **mixed-protocol** route (`opencode`: anthropic-messages +
  openai-completions + openai-responses + google-generative-ai) has no shared
  api, so any model missing from the installed catalog is rejected outright:
  hand-adding it errors, and a settings-only sync has to drop it.

dsh-pi-ai-sync README · Why：`dsh-pi-ai-sync` fixes the root cause instead of working around it: it copies
the missing records into the installed catalog, then lets the (now complete)
catalog serve the route.

dsh-pi-ai-sync README · How it works：```
one round, per managed route
  1. GET https://pi.dev/api/models/providers/<route>     (catalog-shaped records)
  2. catalog layer  → copy records the installed catalog is missing into
                       dist/providers/data/<route>.json

A **layer** is where the data lives (the pi-ai catalog / the `llm-pi-ai`
settings); a round touches both, in that order, for every managed route.

dsh-pi-ai-sync README · How it works：Because the catalog is imported into memory at boot, step 2 only takes effect
after a dsh restart — a round that added models reports `restartNeeded`.

dsh-pi-ai-sync README · Install：Not on npm yet — install it from GitHub today:

```bash
dsh-pi-ai-sync README · newest `main` (what you want while the plugin is still young)：dsh plugin --profile web add github:jiaruihuang/dsh-pi-ai-sync
section: newest `main` (what you want while the plugin is still young)

dsh-pi-ai-sync README · or from a local checkout:：dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-pi-ai-sync
```

Restart dsh afterwards (bundle-layer change).

text:
dsh-pi-ai-sync README · Behind a proxy：This plugin reaches pi.dev with Node's global `fetch`, which **ignores**
`http_proxy` / `https_proxy` unless Node is told to read them. On a network
that only reaches pi.dev through a proxy, a round fails with a bare
`TypeError: fetch failed` — and only sometimes, because the direct route is
usually still there for other hosts. Start dsh with:

```bash
NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1 dsh web          # Node >= 24; see: node --help | grep proxy
```

dsh-pi-ai-sync README · Behind a proxy：(`--use-env-proxy` is the same switch as a CLI flag.) `NO_PROXY` is honoured
either way. This is a host setting on purpose: reading the environment from
inside the plugin would mean taking on an HTTP-proxy dependency, and this
package has none.

dsh-pi-ai-sync README · Configuration：Edit the `pi-ai-sync` section of your settings document (on the dsh 0.1.x line
that is `~/.dsh/settings.yaml`):

```yaml
pi-ai-sync:
  managedRoutes:
    - opencode
    - opencode-go

dsh-pi-ai-sync README · Configuration：| Key | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `managedRoutes` | `[]` | Routes to sync; empty = `opencode`, `opencode-go` |
| `settingsMode` | `unset` | `unset` removes the route's `models` override; `mirror` rewrites it from pi.dev; `keep` leaves settings alone |
| `catalogSync` | `true` | Maintain the installed pi-ai catalog files (the core layer) |
| `updateExistingModels` | `false` | Also refresh records the catalog **already has** with the fields pi.dev states today |
| `intervalMinutes` | `240` | Auto-refresh interval; `0` = startup only |
| `startupDelaySeconds` | `5` | Delay before the first auto round |
| `refreshTimeoutMs` | `120000` | Abort budget for one round's request |
| `fetchAttempts` | `3` | Fetch attempts per route, with exponential backoff; `1` disables retrying |
| `syncNotify` | `true` | Log the report when there was something to report |
| `keepCatalogOnly` | `true` | In `mirror` mode, also write ids that exist only in the catalog |

dsh-pi-ai-sync README · Choosing `settingsMode`：`models` **replaces** the served catalog. dsh resolves
`configured.length > 0 ? configured : catalog`, so a non-empty list stops the
catalog's own list from being used at all. That is what makes the three modes
different things:

dsh-pi-ai-sync README · Choosing `settingsMode`：| Value | What it does to `llm-pi-ai.providers.<route>.models` | Use it when |
|---|---|---|
| `unset` (default) | removes the key; `modelOverrides` is deliberately left alone | you want the enriched catalog to be the single source of truth — the plugin's design |
| `mirror` | writes the full list: pi.dev entries the catalog can back, plus catalog-only ids as bare `{ id }` | you want the list visible and editable in settings (dsh-model-sync's behaviour) |
| `keep` | nothing — the catalog layer only | you manage the list entirely yourself |

dsh-pi-ai-sync README · Choosing `settingsMode`：- `mirror` **rewrites the whole list every round**, so hand-edited fields on it
  do not survive. To hand-tune a model, leave `models` out — see below.
- `mirror` refuses a route with non-empty `modelOverrides`: dsh rejects the two
  together ("models already replaces the served catalog").
- `keep` does **not** mean "the catalog decides". If you leave a non-empty
  `models` list, that list is still what serves the route.
- `keepCatalogOnly` (default `true`) is what holds catalog-only models in the
  mirror list; `false` drops them from the picker.

dsh-pi-ai-sync README · Hand-tuning a model without `models`：When a route has **no** `models` key, dsh builds the list from the catalog and
then applies `modelOverrides` per id:

```yaml
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    opencode:
      apiKeyEnv: OPENCODE_API_KEY

dsh-pi-ai-sync README · Hand-tuning a model without `models`：The route then offers every catalog model, with your values layered on. This is
the shape `settingsMode: unset` leaves in place. dsh enforces three rules:
`modelOverrides` may only name ids the installed catalog describes, it cannot
sit beside a non-empty `models`, and its fields are `name`,
`contextWindow`, `maxTokens`, `input`, `reasoningEfforts`, `compat` — no
`api` and no `id` (the id is the dict key).

dsh-pi-ai-sync README · Why some ids are "catalog-only"：Two lists move independently:

- the **catalog on disk** — the factory snapshot plus every id past rounds
  merged in, and merges are add-only;
- **pi.dev's live listing** — which gains and drops models over time.

dsh-pi-ai-sync README · Why some ids are "catalog-only"：An id the catalog has and pi.dev currently does not list is *catalog-only*. It
is not a pi.dev error and nothing was deleted: the catalog is the union of
everything ever seen, so the two differ whenever pi.dev stops offering an id.
In practice that is mostly the promo `-free` and experimental `-exp` models,
which rotate out — and the count moves on its own (observed: `opencode` at 85
ids, then 83, twenty minutes later).

dsh-pi-ai-sync README · Why some ids are "catalog-only"：Removal is deliberately out of scope for v0.1: a partial pi.dev outage or a
bad network day must never delete models from your picker.

dsh-pi-ai-sync README · Refreshing records you already have：The catalog merge is **add-only**: a record that is already there is never
touched, which is what keeps a partial pi.dev listing from rewriting your
models. The cost is that a model whose parameters pi.dev later corrected keeps
the stale values forever.

dsh-pi-ai-sync README · Refreshing records you already have：`updateExistingModels: true` closes that gap. Only the fields pi.dev actually
states are applied — a `cost` or capacity pi.dev stays silent about keeps the
catalog's value, so nothing is zeroed out by omission — and a record pi.dev has
moved to another protocol is re-grouped under the new `api` instead of leaving
dsh speaking the old one. It is still never a removal.

Measured on a real profile (see `AGENTS.md` for the same numbers):

dsh-pi-ai-sync README · Refreshing records you already have：| Route | Records refreshed | Protocol moves |
|---|---|---|
| `opencode` | 65 (baseUrl, `type`, `inputLimits`, compat, cost…) | 0 |
| `opencode-go` | 31 (`step-5-preview-free`: 8k → 1M context, 4096 → 65536 maxTokens) | **7** — e.g. `claude-haiku-5-5` openai-completions → anthropic-messages |

That second column is the point: 7 models had been flattened to
`openai-completions` by an earlier plugin, so dsh was addressing them with the
wrong wire protocol.

dsh-pi-ai-sync README · Refreshing records you already have：`baseUrl` is the one field to look at twice. pi.dev moved `opencode` to its new
`inference/*` host where the catalog (and that earlier plugin) had
`zen/*`. Both families are live and identical — measured 2026-10-15,
`/zen/v1/models` and `/inference/v1/models` both answer 200 with the same 86
ids — so following pi.dev here is safe today. To pin an endpoint instead, set
`baseURL` on the route in `llm-pi-ai`: a route-level `baseURL` overrides a
record's `baseUrl` while everything else still tracks pi.dev.

dsh-pi-ai-sync README · Refreshing records you already have：A refreshed catalog needs the same restart as an added one, the report shows
`catalog ↻N（…）`, and the first refresh writes the usual backup.

dsh-pi-ai-sync README · Commands and services：- `/pi-ai-sync` — force one round and print the report (registered through the
  shared command registry when the host provides one).
- `piAiSync.syncNow()` — the same round as a service, for UIs.

dsh-pi-ai-sync README · Caveats：- **The catalog layer writes into `node_modules`.** That is inherent: the
  installed pi-ai catalog is the only place dsh 0.1.x can learn a protocol for
  a base-less model. Writes are atomic, a first-modification backup is kept,
  and a real uninstall restores it (a pi-ai upgrade that wholly replaces the
  file is left untouched). A pi-ai upgrade wipes the additions; the next round
  re-applies them.
- **A round says why it gave up.** A failed fetch is retried `fetchAttempts`
  times (default 3) with exponential backoff, then that route is skipped and the
  report carries the whole cause chain — `fetch failed ← connect ETIMEDOUT
  172.67.221.13:443` rather than a bare `fetch failed`. A 4xx other than 429 is
  pi.dev answering, so it is not retried. Skipping is deliberate: **a route whose
  listing could not be verified keeps its settings untouched.**
- **Restart to see new models.** Catalog changes are read at boot only.
- **Do not run this beside `dsh-model-sync` on the same routes.** One rewrites
  `models`, the other unsets it. Pick one.
- **`mirror` + `modelOverrides`.** A route with non-empty `modelOverrides` is
  skipped in `mirror` mode (fold

dsh-pi-ai-sync README · Development：```bash
npm install
npm run build   # tsc → lib/
npm run check   # tsc --noEmit
npm test        # node --test (pretest builds)

See [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md) for the architecture, the host facts this
implementation relies on, and the roadmap.

dsh-pi-ai-sync README · dsh-pi-ai-sync：[简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md) | English

一个 [dsh](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的 Cordis 插件：通过与
pi.dev 网关同步，同时维护一个模型必须经过的**两层**：

- **pi-ai catalog**（`@earendil-works/pi-ai/dist/providers/data/<route>.json`）——
  「dsh 认不认识这个模型、它说哪种协议」这一层；
- **settings 模型清单**（`llm-pi-ai.providers.<route>.models`）——
  「模型选择器列不列得出来」这一层。

dsh-pi-ai-sync README · dsh-pi-ai-sync：它是 [`dsh-model-sync`](https://github.com/fan56/dsh-model-sync)（settings seam）与
[`dsh-opencode-go-models`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-opencode-go-models)
（pi-ai catalog 文件）的融合，且不需要维护协议/家族映射表——pi.dev 的清单里每条记录
本来就是 pi-ai catalog 的形状。

dsh-pi-ai-sync README · 为什么需要它：dsh 解析一个模型走哪种协议的规则是
`route.api ?? catalog[id].api ?? sharedCatalogApi(route)`。在 dsh 0.1.x 线上，
settings 的模型 schema **没有 per-model 的 `api` 字段**，于是：

- 单一协议的路由没问题——路由级 api 能兜底；
- **混合协议**的路由（`opencode`：anthropic-messages + openai-completions +
  openai-responses + google-generative-ai）没有共用 api，任何不在已安装 catalog
  里的模型都会被直接拒绝：手动加报错，纯 settings 同步只能把它丢掉。

`dsh-pi-ai-sync` 不绕过，而是修根因：把缺失的记录补进已安装的 catalog，再让（现在
完整的）catalog 去服务这条路由。

dsh-pi-ai-sync README · 工作原理：```
每轮，对每个受管路由
  1. GET https://pi.dev/api/models/providers/<route>     （catalog 形状的记录）
  2. catalog 层  → 把已安装 catalog 缺失的记录补进
                  dist/providers/data/<route>.json

**层（layer）指数据住在哪**：pi-ai catalog / `llm-pi-ai` settings。一轮同步会按顺序对每个受管路由处理这两层。

catalog 只在 dsh 启动时读进内存，所以第 2 步要**重启**才生效——本轮若补了模型，报告
会带 `restartNeeded`。

dsh-pi-ai-sync README · 安装：尚未发布到 npm，目前从 GitHub 安装：

```bash
dsh-pi-ai-sync README · 跟随最新的 main（插件早期阶段推荐）：dsh plugin --profile web add github:jiaruihuang/dsh-pi-ai-sync
section: 跟随最新的 main（插件早期阶段推荐）

dsh-pi-ai-sync README · 或从本地目录：：dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-pi-ai-sync
```

装完需重启 dsh（bundle 层变更）。

dsh-pi-ai-sync README · GitHub 安装需要放行构建脚本：`github:` 安装会执行包的 `prepare` 脚本（而非 `prepublishOnly`）—— 因为仓库里
只有 TypeScript 源码，`lib/` 是被 gitignore 的编译产物。pnpm 默认拦截安装期脚本，
所以要把 pnpm 打印出来的那把 key 加进 profile 的 `pnpm-workspace.yaml`：

```yaml

  "dsh-pi-ai-sync@git+https://github.com/jiaruihuang/dsh-pi-ai-sync.git": true
```

请用这个形式，不要用裸包名 `dsh-pi-ai-sync: true`（pnpm 无法把包名匹配到 git 来源），
也不要用 pnpm 报错信息里建议的 commit 固定形式 `…/tar.gz/<sha>` —— 固定形式在你下次
push 后就失效，而 `git+https` 形式不会。dshmarket 的「允许构建脚本并重试」按钮会把
两种形式都写进去。

text:
dsh-pi-ai-sync README · 走代理的环境：本插件用 Node 全局的 `fetch` 访问 pi.dev，而它**默认不读** `http_proxy` / `https_proxy`。如果所在网络只有走代理才能到 pi.dev，一轮同步就会失败并只报一个 `TypeError: fetch failed`——而且是**偶发**的，因为其它主机往往还能直连。启动 dsh 时加上：

```bash
NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1 dsh web          # Node >= 24；可用 node --help | grep proxy 确认
```

（`--use-env-proxy` 是同一个开关的命令行写法。）`NO_PROXY` 两种写法都生效。这**刻意做成宿主设置**：从插件内部读代理环境意味着引入一个 HTTP 代理依赖，而本包目前零运行时依赖。

dsh-pi-ai-sync README · 配置：编辑 settings 文档里的 `pi-ai-sync` 段（dsh 0.1.x 线上即 `~/.dsh/settings.yaml`）：

```yaml
pi-ai-sync:
  managedRoutes:
    - opencode
    - opencode-go

dsh-pi-ai-sync README · 配置：| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `managedRoutes` | `[]` | 要同步的路由；留空 = `opencode`、`opencode-go` |
| `settingsMode` | `unset` | `unset` 移除路由的 `models` 覆盖；`mirror` 用 pi.dev 重写；`keep` 不动 settings |
| `catalogSync` | `true` | 维护已安装的 pi-ai catalog 文件（核心层） |
| `updateExistingModels` | `false` | 同时用 pi.dev 当前的字段刷新 catalog **已有**的记录 |
| `intervalMinutes` | `240` | 自动刷新间隔；`0` = 只跑启动轮 |
| `startupDelaySeconds` | `5` | 第一轮前的延迟 |
| `refreshTimeoutMs` | `120000` | 单轮网络超时 |
| `syncNotify` | `true` | 有内容时把报告写进日志 |
| `keepCatalogOnly` | `true` | `mirror` 模式下，把"只存在于 catalog 里"的 id 也一并写出 |

dsh-pi-ai-sync README · 怎么选 `settingsMode`：`models` 是**整份替换**catalog 的。dsh 的判断是
`configured.length > 0 ? configured : catalog`——一旦列表非空，catalog 自己那份就不再被使用。**这正是三个模式的分界线**：

| 值 | 对 `llm-pi-ai.providers.<route>.models` 做什么 | 什么时候用 |
|---|---|---|
| `unset`（默认） | 删掉这个键；`modelOverrides` 故意保留 | 想让补齐后的 catalog 当唯一事实来源——插件的设计默认 |
| `mirror` | 写出完整列表：pi.dev 中 catalog 兜得住的条目 + catalog-only 的 id（裸 `{ id }`） | 想在 settings 里看得见、能编辑这份列表（= dsh-model-sync 的行为） |
| `keep` | 什么都不做，只跑 catalog 层 | 列表完全由你自己管 |

选之前值得知道的几点：

dsh-pi-ai-sync README · 怎么选 `settingsMode`：- `mirror` **每轮都会整份重写**，所以你在它写出的条目上手工改的字段**不会保留**。想微调某个模型，就不要用 `models`——见下。
- `mirror` 对带有非空 `modelOverrides` 的路由**拒写**：dsh 不允许两者并存（*"models already replaces the served catalog"*）。
- `keep` **不等于**"由 catalog 决定"。只要你留着非空的 `models`，服务的仍然是那份列表。
- `keepCatalogOnly`（默认 `true`）就是它把 catalog-only 的模型留在 mirror 列表里；设成 `false` 它们就从选择器里消失。

dsh-pi-ai-sync README · 不用 `models` 也能微调模型：当路由**没有** `models` 键时，dsh 用 catalog 生成列表，然后逐条叠加 `modelOverrides`：

```yaml
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    opencode:
      apiKeyEnv: OPENCODE_API_KEY

这样该路由提供**全部** catalog 模型，其中你指定的字段被覆盖。这也正是 `settingsMode: unset` 保留下来的形状。dsh 会严格校验三条：`modelOverrides` 只能写 catalog 已描述的 id；不能与非空 `models` 并存；字段只有 `name`、`contextWindow`、`maxTokens`、`input`、`reasoningEfforts`、`compat`——**没有 `api`、没有 `id`**（id 就是字典的键）。
section: 不用 `models` 也能微调模型

text:
dsh-pi-ai-sync README · 为什么会有 "catalog-only" 的 id：两份列表各走各的：

- **磁盘上的 catalog**——出厂快照 + 历次同步合并进来的 id，而且合并**只增不删**；
- **pi.dev 的实时列表**——会不断增删模型。

所以"catalog 里有、pi.dev 此刻没列"的 id 就叫 catalog-only。它**不是 pi.dev 记录出错，也没有任何东西被删除**：catalog 是"历来见过的并集"，两份列表只要 pi.dev 不再提供某个 id 就会产生差异。实际上绝大多数是促销性质的 `-free` 和实验性的 `-exp` 模型在轮换下架——这个数字自己会动（实测 `opencode` 先是 85 个，二十分钟后 83 个）。

v0.1 故意不做删除：pi.dev 短暂故障或网络不好的一天，**绝不能**把你的模型从选择器里删掉。
section: 为什么会有 "catalog-only" 的 id

text:
dsh-pi-ai-sync README · 刷新"已经有了"的记录：catalog 的合并是**只增不改**的：已存在的记录永远不动——这正是"pi.dev 某次给不全时不会重写你的模型"的保障。代价是：pi.dev 后来修正过的参数，会一直停留在旧值上。

`updateExistingModels: true` 补上这个缺口。它**只应用 pi.dev 明确给出的字段**——pi.dev 没提的 `cost` 或容量保持 catalog 原值，不会被"缺省"清零；pi.dev 把某个模型换了协议时，记录会被搬到新的 `api` 分组，而不是继续用旧协议。它始终**不会删除**任何记录。

真机实测（同样的数字也记在 `AGENTS.md` 里）：

dsh-pi-ai-sync README · 刷新"已经有了"的记录：| 路由 | 刷新的记录数 | 协议迁移 |
|---|---|---|
| `opencode` | 65（`baseUrl`、`type`、`inputLimits`、compat、cost…） | 0 |
| `opencode-go` | 31（`step-5-preview-free`：8K → 1M 上下文，4096 → 65536 输出） | **7** —— 例如 `claude-haiku-5-5` 从 openai-completions 改为 anthropic-messages |

第二列才是重点：有 7 个模型被上一个插件统一写成了 `openai-completions`，于是 dsh 一直在用错误的协议去请求它们。

dsh-pi-ai-sync README · 刷新"已经有了"的记录：`baseUrl` 是唯一需要多看一眼的字段。pi.dev 已把 `opencode` 挪到新的 `inference/*` 域名，而 catalog（和上一个插件）里还是 `zen/*`。两套域名目前**都活着且内容完全相同**——2026-10-15 实测：`/zen/v1/models` 与 `/inference/v1/models` 都返回 200，同样是 86 个 id——所以这里跟随 pi.dev 是安全的。想固定某个地址，就在 `llm-pi-ai` 里给该路由设 `baseURL`：路由级的 `baseURL` 会覆盖单条记录的 `baseUrl`，其它字段照旧跟随 pi.dev。

刷新后的 catalog 和新增一样**需要重启**；报告里显示 `catalog ↻N（…）`；首次刷新同样会写备份。

dsh-pi-ai-sync README · 命令与服务：- `/pi-ai-sync`——强制跑一轮并打印报告（宿主提供命令注册表时自动注册）。
- `piAiSync.syncNow()`——同一轮的服务形式，供 UI 调用。

dsh-pi-ai-sync README · 注意事项：- **catalog 层会写 `node_modules`。** 这是绕不开的：dsh 0.1.x 里，base-less
  模型的协议只能从已安装的 pi-ai catalog 学到。写入是原子的、首次修改前有备份、
  真卸载时会还原（被 pi-ai 升级整体替换过的文件则不动）。pi-ai 升级会覆盖这些新增，
  下一轮会重新补上。
- **一轮会说明“为什么放弃”。** 拉取失败会按 `fetchAttempts`（默认 3）指数退避重试，之后跳过该路由，并在报告里带上完整的 cause 链——`fetch failed ← connect ETIMEDOUT 172.67.221.13:443`，而不是光秃秃一句 `fetch failed`。4xx（429 除外）是 pi.dev 的答复而非抖动，不会重试。跳过是刻意的：**无法验证列表的路由，settings 一个字都不动。**
- **新模型要重启才看得到。** catalog 只在启动时读。
- **不要和 `dsh-model-sync` 在同一批路由上并用。** 一个重写 `models`，一个删除
  `models`。二选一。
- **`mirror` + `modelOverrides`。** `mirror` 模式会跳过带非空 `modelOverrides`
  的路由（折叠/持久化 override 是 `dsh-model-sync` 的 models-store 职责）。`unset`
  模式不受影响，且是推荐的默认值。

npm run build   # tsc → lib/
npm run check   # tsc --noEmit
